# Set up

Load tidyverse and read climate data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

climate <- read_csv('https://bit.ly/3kKErEb')

my_countries <- c('Brazil', 'China', 'India', 
                  'Turkey', 'United States')
```

Create data visualization

```{r}
my_countries_df <- climate %>% 
  filter(country %in% my_countries) 

my_countries_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = country, fill = country)) + 
  geom_bar()
```
